kwargs.content:
You are analyzing a COMPLETE multi-page Proof of Delivery (POD) PDF packet in ONE request.
Read EVERY page of the attached PDF. Do not stop after the first page. Do not invent pages that are not present.

🚨 CRITICAL RULE: The broker for this shipment is 'T3RA Logistics'. This is the freight broker who arranged the shipment, NOT the carrier company.

❌ NEVER extract 'T3RA Logistics' or similar variations as the 'carrier_name'.

✅ The carrier is the actual trucking company or cargo company that physically transported the goods. If you cannot find a different carrier name than 'T3RA Logistics', then DO NOT extract any carrier information and mark it as null.

Return ONLY a single JSON object with this exact top-level shape:
{
  "document_summary": {
    "page_count": <integer>,
    "page_types_seen": ["BILL_OF_LADING", "LUMPER_RECEIPT", "..."],
    "notes": "brief packet-level notes"
  },
  "pages": [
    {
      "page_number": 1,
      "page_type": "...",
      "fields": [
        {
          "key": "...",
          "value": "...",
          "confidence": 1-100,
          "context_snippet": "..."
        }
      ],
      "proof_of_receipt": {
        "has_receiver_signature": true/false,
        "receiver_signature_location": "...",
        "has_stamp": true/false,
        "delivery_confirmation_reasoning": "..."
      },
      "stop_times": [
        {
          "pickup_checkin_time": "",
          "pickup_checkout_time": "",
          "delivery_checkin_time": "",
          "delivery_checkout_time": ""
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "reconciled": {
    "fields": [
      {
        "key": "...",
        "value": "...",
        "confidence": 1-100,
        "source_pages": [1, 3],
        "context_snippet": "..."
      }
    ],
    "proof_of_receipt": {
      "has_receiver_signature": true/false,
      "receiver_signature_location": "...",
      "has_stamp": true/false,
      "delivery_confirmation_reasoning": "..."
    },
    "stop_times": [
      {
        "pickup_checkin_time": "",
        "pickup_checkout_time": "",
        "delivery_checkin_time": "",
        "delivery_checkout_time": ""
      }
    ],
    "delivery_confirmed": true/false
  }
}

SCHEMA AND INSTRUCTIONS:
CRITICAL RULE: If you cannot find a specific piece of information with high confidence, DO NOT GUESS. Omit that field from the "fields" array. It is better to have a missing field than an incorrect one.

--- MULTI-PAGE RULES ---
1. Include one object in "pages" for EVERY page in the PDF, in order, starting at page_number=1.
2. Extract independently per page first. Do not copy values from another page unless they are visibly present on that page.
3. After all pages are extracted, build "reconciled":
   - Prefer higher-confidence values.
   - Prefer BILL_OF_LADING / warehouse receipt / delivery ticket evidence over blank or UNKNOWN pages.
   - For po_number: collect ALL distinct PO/Delivery identifiers seen across pages (one fields entry per distinct value, or one comma-separated value only if multiple appear together on the same evidence block). Prefer listing distinct values as separate field objects with the same key "po_number".
   - For carrier_name: never use 'T3RA Logistics'. If conflicting carriers appear, choose the clearest trucking/carrier label and lower confidence; mention conflict in context_snippet.
   - For proof_of_receipt: OR the evidence across pages. If ANY page has a valid receiver signature/RECVR name or stamp, set the reconciled flags accordingly and cite the best page in reasoning.
   - delivery_confirmed = true only if reconciled proof shows receiver signature/RECVR evidence and/or clear delivery stamp/confirmation language.
4. Blank, cover, terms, or unreadable pages: page_type="UNKNOWN", empty fields, proof false/"N/A", stop_times with empty strings.
5. Ignore rate confirmations, invoices, and unrelated attachments if mixed in; still list them as UNKNOWN pages.

--- LOCATION & ADDRESS RULES (VERY IMPORTANT) ---
1. pickup_location / pickup_address MUST come from sections labeled Shipper / From / Origin / Ship Site.
2. destination_location / destination_address MUST come from Consignee / To / Destination / Ship To.
3. NEVER mix shipper and consignee blocks.
4. Use visual layout carefully; do not assign a shipper address as destination.

--- GENERAL FIELDS (per page and reconciled) ---
1. page_type must be one of: "BILL_OF_LADING", "LUMPER_RECEIPT", "ITEMIZED_LIST", "UNKNOWN".
2. fields[].key must be one of:
   "carrier_name", "po_number", "pickup_location", "pickup_address",
   "destination_location", "destination_address", "stamp_company_name"
3. fields[].value is a string.
4. fields[].confidence is 1-100.
5. fields[].context_snippet is a short surrounding text snippet.
6. proof_of_receipt:
   - has_receiver_signature: true only for signature in CONSIGNEE/RECEIVER section OR printed name in Receiver/RECVR on a warehouse/gate receipt. Do NOT count carrier/driver signatures.
   - receiver_signature_location: "Consignee Box" | "On Stamp" | "Receiver Field" | "Handwritten Note" | "N/A"
   - has_stamp: true if a company ink stamp is visible
   - delivery_confirmation_reasoning: brief specific evidence summary

--- FIELD-SPECIFIC RULES ---
- carrier_name: actual trucking/cargo company that hauled the freight (e.g. 'Bajwa Truckers'). Look on BOL / lumper / warehouse carrier lines. Catch strike-throughs/updates. If only 'T3RA Logistics' appears, omit carrier_name / null.
- po_number: extract clean PO / Delivery numeric-alphanumeric IDs only. Do not miss middle digits. Do not include surrounding words.

--- STOP TIMES (REQUIRED on every page and in reconciled) ---
Always include stop_times.
Look for check-in/out, arrival/departure, gate in/out, appointment, scheduled/actual, IN/OUT, APP/ARR/IN/OUT style warehouse times.
For each logical stop on that page, add one object with:
  pickup_checkin_time, pickup_checkout_time, delivery_checkin_time, delivery_checkout_time
Use "" when unknown/not applicable.
TIMESTAMP FORMAT for every non-empty time: ISO 8601 UTC "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ".
Convert document local times; if timezone unknown, keep the wall-clock time and still append Z only if the document implies UTC; otherwise convert when timezone is stated, else encode the printed local time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ using the document date if present.
If no times on a page:
[{"pickup_checkin_time":"","pickup_checkout_time":"","delivery_checkin_time":"","delivery_checkout_time":""}]
In reconciled.stop_times, merge unique pickup/delivery stops found across pages (do not invent times).

OUTPUT RULES:
- Return JSON only. No markdown. No commentary outside JSON.
- page_count must equal the number of objects in "pages".
- Be precise; omit uncertain fields rather than guessing.

kwargs.template: Analyze the attached complete POD PDF across all pages and return the JSON schema above.
